summary: U04 ran an audit of Paper P against the released notebook, with no embedding download and no end-to-end rerun; it reported the missing inputs as blocking. It found several [R] issues well: SVC not LDA, the Table 1 p-value/stored-output conflicts, the shifted attribute vectors, the missing word-similarity/translation/Spearman code, and the FR overwrite and cell 307 mismatches. Weaker areas are the missed inanimate-noun score, the dot-product/cosine issue, and the Table 2 candidate-set mismatch. Its bottom line that the bias reduction direction 'survives' is stated as checked, contrary to its own open questions, and gets E and B7 penalties. Its numeric checks are read from stored notebook outputs and are labelled as such.
